source.stem:
A person in a factory has to lift a box on to a shelf.
Which action involves the person doing the least amount of work?

options.text: lifting the box quickly to the high shelf
lifting the box slowly to the high shelf
lifting the box to the low shelf first then lifting it to the high shelf
lifting the box to the low shelf instead of to the high shelf

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: The disconnected electromagnet has South at A and North at B.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: A is North; B is South.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: The facing end of the second electromagnet is North.

intelligence.enrichment: An electromagnet has two poles, North and South; if the north pole of a compass is attracted to one end of the electromagnet, that end is the South pole and the other end has the opposite polarity. unlike magnetic poles attract -> compass north pole moves toward the electromagnet's South pole -> the opposite end of the electromagnet has the opposite pole The learner correctly applies this rule: An electromagnet has two poles, North and South; if the north pole of a compass is attracted to one end of the electromagnet, that end is the South pole and the other end has the opposite polarity. If the compass north pole points toward an end, that end must also be North.
